sanskrit_verse:
देशग्रामगृहघ्नाश्च पथिघ्ना ग्रन्थिमोचकाः।
इत्येवमादयो ज्ञेया अप्रकाशाश्च तस्कराः॥
transliteration:
deśagrāmagṛhaghnāśca pathighnā granthimocakāḥ |
ityevamādayo jñeyā aprakāśāśca taskarāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who destroy land, villages, homes; those who obstruct paths; those who sever sacred bonds—such beings, along with all unmanifest thieves, are known as taskarāḥ.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with Sanatana Dharma, not state power
Causation arises through disruption of dharmic continuity and spatial integrity
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by one's ability to sustain or sever connection
Restoration logic demands reconnection to source-consciousness and spatial harmony
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of unity between self, space, and community
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent disrupts geographical or structural sanctity THEN initiate restoration protocol via spatial re-consecration
IF entity severs relational or textual continuity THEN enforce completion process until coherence restored
IF being operates in unmanifest mode causing systemic decay THEN invoke consciousness-alignment mechanism
IF damage occurs to collective infrastructure THEN assign proportional reconstruction duty based on capacity
IF obstruction blocks access THEN remove impediment and restore energetic flow through Nyaya-based mediation
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, any act that undermines territorial sanctity, communal infrastructure, or sacred knowledge transmission invokes immediate restorative jurisdiction. The threshold of responsibility lies in the measurable impact on dharma-vyavastha, not intent. Authority flows from recognition of unity-consciousness, not coercive hierarchy.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that destruction of place or path distorts pramāṇa itself. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how severance propagates disconnection. Proportionality aligns with the extent of reintegration required. Non-punitive reality rule confirms suffering has no causal role in correction—only conscious realignment does.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Pathway Reconnection Ritual to dissolve spatial fragmentation
Enforce Sacred Bond Renewal Process for those who have severed relational ties
Undertake Spatial Consecration Completion to heal violated geographies
Activate Knowledge Continuity Restoration for disrupted scriptural or cultural transmissions
Implement Consciousness Alignment Sequence to reintegrate hidden offenders
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law emanates from the Source-Consciousness alone. Dharma stands restored when unity-awareness prevails. Reality remains ever non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
